notes.title: Patchnotes v1.1 - Bonus Levels!
notes.content:
Hey everyone, we're back with another patch! And this one is a big one, so let the download roll in, or turn on auto-updates if you didn't receive it yet!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28205068/4da325f4ab78785c0d4843171f1de7e1e4e20048.jpg

Bonus Levels
We have added a new feature in the menu! The Bonus Levels window allows us to add new levels to Eye in the Sky when we think we've come up with something cool in our spare time!

BL_Amazing
Added the bonus level "Amazing" (obviously)
developer's note: "Amazing" is an attempt at making something a bit different. It's less escape-roomy like most levels in the campaign and more to the point with only one or two main puzzles. The main goal for me was to make sure both VR and PC would have to communicate a lot to get through this, and I think it definitely works. Can you make it through without losing a single Light to the invisible lasers? :) Muahaha!

Sewers_2
Added a sign to make sure people read the symbols from left to right
Adjusted the symbol buttons to have the same orientation as the Light's symbols
Small adjustment to the pipe-jump part at the end of the level

Sewers_3
The barrel-jump distances across the water have been shortened

Sewers_4
Added a hidden sign to clarify how the ending of the level should work


As always a huge thanks for playing our game, and we hope you enjoy the addition of a new level!

~ The VinLia Games team



p.s. Our main designer, Feroxxy, has set up a Patreon page. She'll post ocassionally about her TARDIS VR project, new levels for Eye in the Sky, and new games that are in the making. Check her out at Patreon.com/Feroxxy !

notes.title: Patchnotes v1.0.2
notes.content:
Hey all, just another couple of fixes headed your way!


InnerCity_1
Fixed an issue which would cause huge framerate spikes when moving an item through a laser receptor
Fixed an issue in which the pc player could move through the containment unit
Added an invisible wall so pc players won't prematurely enter the side room
The password squares should now properly reset
Improved the password hint note
Made the big barrel jumps for the pc player easier
Tweaked a few textures which were outdated



As always a huge thanks for playing our game and we hope you're having fun with it! Don't forget to poke us on the community hub if you run into any issues!

~ the VinLia Games team

notes.title: Patchnotes v1.0.1 - small batch of fixes
notes.content:
Hey everyone, here's a small patch fixing some issues which we found thanks to player feedback! Thanks for helping, and don't be shy to let us know if you walk into problems with Eye in the Sky!

As always be sure to have auto updates on, and if it's not updating just close and reopen Steam to download the latest patch.


Patchnotes v1.0.1

Fixed the Bucket in Tutorial, which wasn't always accepting your cube offerings
Added a short audio notification upon completing Tutorial
Fixed the visual effects of the Buttons in Junkyard_4
The goo showers in Junkyard_5 will kill the Light now, as was intended
Improved the pathing of jumps in Sewers_1
Changed the light puzzle in Sewers_1 to avoid trial and erroring.
The camera of the Light should now clip less while walking through the Sewer tunnels
Other small issues resolved like sound adjustments, water shader fix, invisible wall changes

notes.title: Patchnotes v1.0 - Oculus Support, New levels, Leaving Early Access
notes.content:
Oh goody, it's here!

As always be sure to have auto updates on, and if it's not updating just close and reopen Steam to download the latest patch.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28205068/bcff815a11c5815f49dbf437d7797ae7742ac489.jpg

Oculus Rift

We've been testing the game thoroughly and the answer is clear; Eye in the Sky finally is officially playable with the Oculus Rift + Touch!
	Trigger is for picking up objects
	Press the joystick to use your pointers


General improvements

Small story bits are implemented to make the world a little more alive
Slightly increased the Eye's reach
Slightly improved accessibility of some puzzles for shorter humans playing as the Eye
Minor improvements in all levels like hint notes, more props should help avoid getting stuck too long
Buttons now interact with cubes from a bit further away; this should help Eye players avoid cubes flying away because of them being pressed through the button
Removed disclaimer

 
Level changes

Tutorial
	Brand new level introducing the story and some basic puzzle elements!

Junkyard_1
	Small story bit implemented
	Slight adjustments to some jump puzzles and button placement
	Fixed various deadspots the Light could get stuck in
	
Junkyard_2
	Small changes to make the puzzles pathing more clear
	
Junkyard_3
	Fixed glossy terrain
	Fixed an invisible wall that would let the Light skip the complete level (whoops!)
	Added a password screen to improve clarity of the symbol puzzle
	Light blips on the map are better visible
	
Junkyard_4
	The Light can now escape the barrel room if the Eye lost the Cubes
	Fixed color puzzle - no more trial and erroring
	Fixed deadspot in the hidden room
	
Junkyard_5
	The Eye can reach a bit further into the goo pool to grab lost cubes
	
Sewers_2
	Added password screen to improve clarity of the symbol puzzle
	
Sewers_3
	Slightly increased the size of barrels; this should decrease the Light slipping off when the barrel floats on water
	Improved the pathing of the overall puzzle
	Can no longer skip a big part of the level

Sewers_4
	Spawning pipes is now limited by a resource. Recycle surplus in the incinerator!
	
Inner City_1
	Brand new level introducing lasers, cool color puzzles and a small story finale!
	Inner City takes place after the Eye and Light's escape from the Sewers

	
Other solved issues

The menu should now always load
Legacy SP achievements are removed (go get your 100% now!)
LevelLoader now Loads Levels fully Loaded as the LevelLoader is intended to Load Levels.
Fixed delay on interacting with cranks


Final word

It’s been almost a year since we at VinLia Games started this crazy little project of ours. Eye in the Sky went into Early Access in April and as development continued we learned a lot about what you guys liked and what we wanted to achieve with our game. Your reactions to the game were overwhelmingly positive and we thank all of you for joining us on this development adventure. 
We'll continue to monitor the forum, so if anything goes wrong let us know. But for now, go out there and go have some fun!

~ The Vinlia Games team

notes.title: Patchnotes Eye in the Sky v0.2.4
notes.content:
Hey all. Here's a quick patch trying to get some stability in before summer gets too crazy!

General

Disclaimer adjusted to automatically dissapear when the loading of the game is complete
"Restart Level" should now properly restart a level even if the game failed to load the level the first time



Single Player

Single Player has been removed


We're sorry to announce single player is being shelved. This was originally put in to see what people would think of at least having the oppertunity to play Eye in the Sky when none of their friends were around.

However, these singleplayer levels lacked polish and the gameplay we so carefully designed for 2 players wasn't compelling enough in a single player setting in our eyes.

We quickly noticed the majority of people did not enjoy these levels and even worse, some lost appetite to try out co-op - which is what we intended as the main game content from the start.

With feedback clearly showing people really enjoy playing co-operatively with their friends and family we realised it was best to keep working on making co-op as amazing as it can be and build more levels for that - which in turn meant singleplayer would never get enough attention to shine.

We hope you can accept our decision as we try to bring you even more co-op levels soon!

notes.title: Patchnotes Eye in the Sky v0.2.3 - QoL
notes.content:
We're not sitting still, development on the next chapter of levels has started and as always we're squashing bugs left and right! Here's an overview.
As always be sure to have auto-update on, or you'll have to start the download manually.

General
Items grabbed by the Light no longer teleport with it upon dieing and respawning
Starting a new co-op savefile no longer clears your singleplayer progress
No longer have to deal with Unity's screen settings before booting the game
Cranks no longer jitter when rotating them to their maximum rotation


Menu
Regrouped a lot of settings
Resolution settings are now available
Sliders now show a percentage
Input manager for your key rebinding convenience!
All graphical enhancements (like bloom and motion blur) should now work properly
Loading screens between levels with clearer hints


Co-op campaign
Level 6; the Light should now fall into the Sewers automatically again
Level 7; cranks now move in correct direction according to hints, and
Platform no longer goes underwater

notes.title: Patchnotes Eye in the Sky v0.2b - Achievements!
notes.content:
Another day, another patch. Here's a list of the changes!
As always be sure to have auto-updates on, or you'll have to start the download manually.


General
Added disclaimer to note this is Early Access and Singleplayer is experimental.

Added loading screens with hints for the pc player

Added tracker to log crashes during level transitioning and quitting the game.
If your settings like audio and graphics aren't saved, please help us find out what's causing that and send the log to vinliagames@gmail.com. Logfiles: C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\logs (or wherever you have Steam installed).


Achievements
A first batch of achievements is here! Every one of the twelve levels now has its own shiny picture for you to unlock!

Co-op Campaign
Level 1; Changed the overall puzzle so there is no longer a fail state.
comment: Since there isn't a tutorial it seemed a bit too strict to have a fail state, especially if it doesn't add to the overall puzzle.

Level 3; All symbols are now displayed on ONE sign rather than being split across two.

Level 7; The Energy Cube should now move with the platform. Added an invisible wall so the Light doesn't get stuck in the pipes at the end of the level.

Sewers in general; Camera clipping should now happen less for the Light while walking through pipes.

notes.title: Patchnotes Eye in the Sky v0.2a
notes.content:
Hey guys! Here's a first round of fixes that we immediately encountered. Be sure to have auto-updates on or you'll have to start the update manually.


- Vive controllers now use haptic feedback to tell you when objects you're carrying are colliding with other objects

- VR Singleplayer Magnesis 1; platform now moves in the correct direction

- VR Singleplayer Marbles 2; the last gate now opens and closes correctly, collision issues resolved


All experimental VR singleplayer levels should now be completely playable, let us know if this is a mode you'd like to see more levels for!

As always let us know if you find issues or bugs on the community hub and we'll respond as soon as we can!
